inputs.name: couchdb_version
inputs.description: CouchDB release to install, such as "3.5.3". Raising it upgrades CouchDB in place.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password for CouchDB's server admin. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: bind_address
inputs.description: IP address CouchDB listens on, its [chttpd] bind_address. "0.0.0.0" listens on every IPv4 address, "::" on every address.

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: Port CouchDB listens on, its [chttpd] port.

inputs.name: require_valid_user
inputs.description: Refuse every request that doesn't log in, even GET /. obsidian_livesync turns it on.

inputs.name: cors_origins
inputs.description: Origins allowed to call CouchDB from a browser, such as ["https://app.example.com"], or ["*"] for any. Empty turns CORS off, unless obsidian_livesync is on.

inputs.name: cors_credentials
inputs.description: Let browsers send cookies and Authorization headers with cross-origin requests. CouchDB doesn't allow it with the "*" origin.

inputs.name: cors_headers
inputs.description: Request headers allowed on cross-origin requests. When empty, CouchDB's default: accept, authorization, content-type, origin and referer.

inputs.name: obsidian_livesync
inputs.description: Apply the settings the Self-hosted LiveSync plugin for Obsidian asks for: require_valid_user, CORS for the Obsidian apps with credentials, and larger request and document limits.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: More CouchDB ini settings, by section, such as { couchdb = { max_dbs_open = "1000" } }. The circuit's own settings win over the same keys here.
